Privacy Policy

ERA Systems LTD • Last updated: July 24, 2026

1. Who We Are

ERA Systems LTD ("ERA," "we," "us," or "our") is a systems and operations company based in Abuja, Nigeria (RC 9536766), building SaaS platforms and automation solutions for businesses. This policy covers all products, platforms, and client-built solutions operated by ERA Systems LTD, including software applications, messaging-based tools (such as chatbots), and any other digital service we build and operate for ourselves or on behalf of clients (collectively, the "Services").

Where a specific Service has additional or different data practices due to its nature (for example, a Service handling sensitive health-related data), that Service may be governed by an additional policy or addendum. Where no such addendum exists, this general policy applies.

2. Information We Collect

Depending on which Service you interact with, we may collect:

  • Contact information: name, phone number, email address
  • Communication data: messages sent through WhatsApp, SMS, or in-app chat, including chatbot conversations
  • Account information: business name, role, login credentials
  • Transaction information: order details, payment confirmation status (we do not store full card details — payments are processed through licensed third-party payment providers)
  • Usage data: how you interact with our platforms (pages visited, features used, timestamps)
  • Location data: where relevant to the Service (e.g., logistics, delivery, or scheduling features)
  • Device/technical data: IP address, browser type, device identifiers

We only collect what is reasonably necessary for the specific Service you're using.

3. How We Use Your Information

We use collected information to:

  • Provide, operate, and maintain the Service you're using
  • Respond to messages, inquiries, and support requests (including via WhatsApp chatbots)
  • Process transactions and send related notifications
  • Improve our products and troubleshoot issues
  • Comply with legal obligations under applicable Nigerian law, including the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA) and Nigeria Data Protection Regulation (NDPR)
  • Communicate updates, service changes, or promotional information (where you've consented)

4. WhatsApp & Third-Party Messaging Platforms

Some of our Services operate through WhatsApp Business API and other Meta platforms. When you message us or a chatbot we operate through WhatsApp:

  • Your phone number and message content are processed by us to provide the relevant Service
  • WhatsApp/Meta also processes this data according to their own privacy policy, as the underlying platform provider
  • We do not use your WhatsApp data for purposes unrelated to the Service you contacted us through

5. Data Sharing

We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with:

  • Third-party service providers who help us operate our Services (hosting, payment processing, messaging infrastructure)
  • Legal or regulatory authorities where required by law
  • A client business, where the Service you're using is built or operated by ERA on that client's behalf (for example, a chatbot deployed for a specific business)

6. Data Storage & Security

We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. Data is stored on secure servers, and access is limited to personnel who need it to operate the relevant Service.

7. Your Rights

Under applicable Nigerian data protection law, you have the right to:

  • Request access to the personal data we hold about you
  • Request correction of inaccurate data
  • Request deletion of your data, subject to legal or operational retention requirements
  • Withdraw consent for optional data uses (e.g., marketing communications)

To exercise these rights, contact us using the details in Section 9.

8. Children's Privacy

Our Services are not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

9. Contact Us

For questions about this policy or your data, contact:

ERA Systems LTD
Abuja, Nigeria
hello@erasystems.com.ng
www.erasystems.com.ng

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date above.

ERA Systems LTD • Abuja, Nigeria
